declarations.docstring: A finite-dimensional representation of rank one is isomorphic to a representation of the displayed form.
Pointwise equality of finite dimensions gives equal index filters at every dimension.
The functor induced by a group equivalence preserves the finite dimension of a representation.
Builds an equivalence of finite-dimensional complex representation categories from a group equivalence.
An equivalence functor sends a simple object to a simple object.
A full faithful functor preserving monomorphisms reflects simplicity of an object.
A complete pairwise distinct family of simple representations transfers across a group equivalence while preserving dimensions.
